nodes.label: Research question: feel slippery/soft ground before stepping
AX-12A servo model
nodes.rationale: Sim reproduces real servo imperfections (compliance, torque falloff, 10-bit sensor, backlash, bus delay) so policy transfers; values datasheet estimates, bench measurement pending

nodes.label: Dropped servo reads + 18-bit fresh-reading mask
nodes.rationale: Read failure probability 0.005+0.068*torque/stall; ZOH last good value (deviation D8: load-driven not tracking error)

nodes.label: Joint velocity from two position reads 40 ms apart
nodes.rationale: PhysX velocity is non-deployable

nodes.label: Rest pose +30/+30 (static torque check)
nodes.rationale: Phase 1 pose needed 134% femur stall torque in tripod stance; +30/+30 needs 12%/29%; sim torque readout under-reads ~2x so lever-arm torques used

nodes.label: Terrain curriculum (levels 0-14 train, 15-20 held out)
nodes.rationale: Promote at >=80% commanded path, demote on fall or <40%

nodes.label: Spatial ground material library (10 materials, 4 m cells)
nodes.rationale: Fixed layout so every arm and seed walks the same map; shiny materials cause depth holes

nodes.label: Domain randomization (payload, damping, servo, IMU noise)
Rhythm clock (CPG) scaffolding
nodes.rationale: f_ref = v_cmd/0.20 clamped 0.8-2.5 Hz (below 0.8 robot froze); zeroed when standing; removed with clock rewards over first 30% of S2 per episode never per step

nodes.label: Anticipation loop 30 Hz (planned)
nodes.rationale: Loops unsynchronised so predictions 0-100 ms stale; rem_60/200/400 staleness features, >150 ms switched off

nodes.label: Body-sensing encoder E_p (TCN, W=50, z_p 64-D)
nodes.rationale: Never changed by RL signal; trained by velocity estimation, probes and VICReg

nodes.label: Velocity & force estimator (v_kin + delta v, e-hat 15-D)
nodes.rationale: Must pass slip-stratified and IMU-dropout tests before policy uses it

nodes.label: Old velocity estimator V_0 (retired in S1)
nodes.rationale: Deviation D23: frozen and dropped per episode

nodes.label: Actor union observation layout (unused blocks held at zero)
nodes.rationale: Widened once at S1; zero blocks keep zero-init columns zero; widened actor reproduces prior to <1e-6

nodes.label: Contact memory (last 4 front-leg touchdowns)
nodes.rationale: Lets middle/rear legs anticipate ground they cannot see; optional, removed if no effect

nodes.label: Physics quiz probes (186-D, beta-NLL beta=0.5)
nodes.rationale: Forces encoder to learn about ground; identical for all arms except B1-K

nodes.label: Privileged critic contract P (683-D)
nodes.rationale: Identical for all arms so no arm gains from a better critic; action-independent

nodes.label: EMA slow encoder copy (target)
nodes.rationale: Prevents predictor and encoder collapsing to trivial agreement

nodes.label: Gradient routing tests
nodes.rationale: RL never changes encoders; critic never changes policy; widening test measured exactly 0.0
